intro: An exceptional experience begins with a personal welcome.
customerDescription: Sign in to continue your journey with Brouj.
registerDescription: Create your customer account with a few personal details.
staffDescription: Access your Brouj workspace with your staff account.
logoutRequired: Sign out of the current session before signing in with another account.
busy: A session action is in progress. Please wait before trying again.
signInRequired: Check your current session before signing in.
hydration: Sign in was accepted, but your profile could not be loaded. Check the session again or sign out.
network: Your session could not be checked. Your connection may be unavailable. Try checking again.
expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
refreshUncertain: Session renewal could not be confirmed. Changes are paused. Check your session or sign out before signing in again.
logoutUnconfirmed: Server sign-out was not confirmed. Your current session is retained; please retry sign-out.
locksUnavailable: Automatic session renewal is unavailable in this browser. Sign out, then sign in again.
changed: Your session changed in another tab. Checking your account…
